title: Research: prove the repeated-root UT5 target needs five calls
body:
## Result

Adds an exact scoped minimum for the four-role endpoint `diag([g1],[g1],[g2],[g1*g2])` over the full formal group algebra `F2[UT5(Z)]`. With the eight signed simple-root labels and all 120 binary rank-one idempotents, the minimum is five paid factors, equal to the direct word. A determinant character and a support obstruction reduce any shorter word to length three; a complete exact join covers all `960^3 = 884,736,000` words and finds none.

The fixed endpoint is the first repeated-simple-root / height-two case suggested by the open next question in merged PR #2103 (original claim thread: Discussion #2094). The other UT5 target in that PR is distinct.

## Verification

- `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/ut5-repeated-root-height-two-20261017` — PASS on Python 3.12.15.
- `python3.12 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/ut5-repeated-root-height-two-20261017` — PASS, committed bytes checked.
- `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/ut5-repeated-root-height-two-20261017 --check-only` — PASS.

The exact verifier replays the five-call word, all 921,600 ordered two-factor states, all 960 right-factor queries and their full-group-algebra products, the 16 pair-formula controls, and pinned input hashes. The search uses actual integer `UT5(Z)` support elements; it does not sample a finite address set.

## Scope

The result is only for this endpoint, four dirty roles, and the specified paid alphabet. It establishes no saving, no supplier mapping, no selected-exponent change, and no general tariff. The exact verifier is computer-assisted, not proof-assistant verified. No selected record or `upstream/` file changes.

Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human review is claimed.
